queries.sql: SELECT rolname,rolsuper,rolinherit,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb,rolcanlogin,rolreplication,rolbypassrls,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_auth_members m WHERE m.member=r.oid) AS memberships FROM pg_roles r WHERE rolname=$1
SELECT nspname,pg_get_userbyid(nspowner) AS owner,nspacl::text FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=$1
SELECT c.relname,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,c.relacl::text FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace=$1::regnamespace ORDER BY c.relname
SELECT * FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE grantee=$1 AND table_schema=$2 ORDER BY table_name,privilege_type
SELECT * FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname=$1 ORDER BY tablename,policyname
